caption: The drawing depicts a square pattern bordered by a faint outline. Within the square, there is a central circular motif with petal-like shapes radiating outward, surrounded by four larger, rounded diamond or oval shapes placed at each corner. These corner shapes are filled with a grid or lattice pattern of diagonal lines. The area outside these main shapes, filling the background, consists of a similar diagonal grid pattern. All patterns, borders, and shapes are rendered in soft, light brown or sepia tones, with shading used to create a slightly raised, embossed effect. The overall background is a light cream or beige color, and the detailed quilted design occupies most of the central area of the drawing, leaving a margin on all sides. The drawing is composed entirely of abstract and geometric forms, with no text or figurative elements.
title: Detail of Quilt - Tulip Pattern
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
